comments: Two tasks cannot be completed with a screen reader: placing a hold, and changing the reminder timing.
Status messages across the catalogue are either not announced or disappear before they can be read.

steps.instructions: Open the catalogue home page and confirm the "Search the catalogue" landmark is reachable.

issues.description: The search landmark is labelled "region" with no accessible name, so screen reader users cannot tell it apart from the three other regions on the page.

steps.instructions: Enter "tide pools" in the search field and submit the search.
Confirm the results heading announces how many titles matched.

issues.description: The result count is rendered before the live region is created, so NVDA announces nothing. Users must navigate to the heading to discover how many titles matched.
The results heading is a <div> styled to look like a heading, so it does not appear in the heading list.

steps.instructions: Filter the results to "Available now" using the Availability checkboxes.

issues.description: Availability is shown with a colored dot and no text alternative, so there is no way to tell a title on the shelf from one already on loan.
The Availability checkboxes are not wrapped in a fieldset, so their shared purpose is never announced.

steps.instructions: Open the first result and review the title detail page.

issues.description: Focus stays on the results list when the detail page loads, so screen reader users are not told the page changed.

steps.instructions: Activate "Place hold" and confirm the hold was placed.

issues.description: The hold confirmation appears in a dialog that never receives focus. Screen reader users have no indication the hold succeeded.
The dialog's close button is an unlabelled icon button, announced only as "button".

tests.name: Search the catalogue and place a hold
tests.goal: Find a title and place a hold on it.
comments: Availability is communicated with color alone, so it is not possible to tell which titles can be borrowed today.
Placing a hold appears to do nothing: the confirmation dialog never takes focus and is not announced.

steps.instructions: Locate the item due soonest and activate "Renew".
Confirm the new due date is shown for that item.

tests.name: Renew a borrowed item
tests.goal: Renew an item that is due soon.

steps.instructions: Change the reminder timing from "3 days before" to "1 week before".

issues.description: The reminder timing control is a custom listbox that cannot be operated with the arrow keys; only a mouse click changes the value.

steps.instructions: Switch the notification channel from email to text message.

issues.description: Choosing "Text message" reveals a phone number field, but the new field is not announced and focus is not moved to it.
The phone number field has a placeholder but no persistent label.
The "Preferences saved" message is styled as a toast and disappears after four seconds, which is not long enough to find it.

steps.instructions: Reload the page and confirm the saved values persist.

issues.description: After reload the reminder timing shows the old value until the page is refreshed a second time.

tests.name: Update notification preferences
tests.goal: Change how and when borrowing reminders are sent.
